headline.value: Every D3B_IAC surface resolves to the SAME footstep events (FS_DEFAULT_*). WFC has no surface-specific robot footstep/landing audio on this map: the per-character HmSoundEventSet chooses the sound (Optimus -> BL_FS_LRG_BOT.*). The rebuild's "generic/default" footsteps are the authored behaviour, not a fallback.
